A '''world''' was located in the [[Almar system/Legends|Almar system]]<ref name="TTaBS" /> of the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This [[Planet/Legends|world]] was often called a tropical paradise, being covered with [[Color/Legends|orange]]-[[Grass/Legends|grass]] hills and shallow [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[marmaw]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]].<ref name="TTaBS" />
